Upon reflection, I realise just how terrible this practice is. My GP worked 2 days a week, the other GPs wouldn’t see me if I needed help on the other days. Basically this meant I only had GP care twice a week if needed. My prescriptions were weekly and if they didn’t provide me with my prescriptions on time, I would have awful side affects. I also regularly was asking for help with chronic pain. I was told many times to wait to speak to the pain team which was months ahead and wouldn’t provide me with further analgesia. It turns out I need spinal surgery. The receptionists are all rude, not one of them considered my neuro diversity when it came to me calling in. One time I called in and gave my details, I heard the receptionist verbally sigh when she realised who she was talking to.
